2 11-12-2024 Heard learned Advocate for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner happens to be the husband of opposite party no.2 is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1022 of 2021, wherein cognizance has been taken for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Allegedly the marriage of the complainant was solemnized with the petitioner in the year, 2015.
However, soon after the marriage, she was subjected to demand of dowry.
The couple blessed with two female child and this has also infuriated the petitioner, resulting into further torture and demand of Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.81819 of 2024(2) dt.11-12-2024 dowry is the allegation levelled in the complaint petition.
4. Learned Advocate for the petitioner contended that in fact on account of some family feud, the present complaint case has been instituted.
The petitioner is ready to keep his wife with full honour and dignity.
